resources.string: Show your NetWatch Find My tags on the ATAK map.
NetWatch runs on your computer. Switch on ATAK bridge there, then connect this tablet to it.
On a VPN such as Tailscale or WireGuard, "Find on my network" will not see anything — there is no broadcast on a VPN. Paste the pairing link instead.
Tags are located through Apple\'s Find My network. A position is where a passing iPhone last heard the tag, not live GPS, so it can be minutes or hours old. Use these on property you own.
